primitives.name: Formula
primitives.summary: 渲染 render-mathjax.cjs 烘出的 MathJax SVG（字形内嵌，不依赖外部字体）

primitives.name: Backdrop
primitives.summary: 整幅背景：底色渐变 + 网格 + 辉光，取主题包 token

primitives.name: ProteinLevels
primitives.summary: 蛋白四级结构：残基带（一级）→ 螺旋/折叠（二级）→ 折叠链（三级）→ 四亚基（四级），level 控制展示到第几级
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, w, level, residues, color, progress })

primitives.name: EnzymeKinetics
primitives.summary: 米氏动力学曲线 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S])：Vmax 渐近线 + Km 处的半速点，可选叠加 Lineweaver-Burk 双倒数线; current substrate point and derived reaction rate
primitives.signature: ({ s, Vmax, Km, color, showLB, progress, substrate })

primitives.name: mmRate
primitives.summary: 米氏方程函数：底物浓度 → 反应速率，供曲线与标签共用，避免图与文案数字漂移

primitives.name: Membrane
primitives.summary: 磷脂双分子层 + 通道/载体/泵三类跨膜蛋白 + 两侧按浓度生成的溶质点云，转运箭头区分顺梯度（被动）与逆梯度（耗 ATP）; visible molecule crossing the bilayer
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, w, thick, outside, inside, transporters: [{kind, at, label, atp, color}], progress, seed, cargo })

primitives.name: IonGradient
primitives.summary: 膜两侧电荷分离：正负离子点云按浓度生成，给出能斯特电位 E = (RT/zF)ln([out]/[in]); final-only equilibrium potential reveal
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, w, h, out, in_, z, rtf, color, progress, seed, showPotential })

primitives.name: ChromosomePair
primitives.summary: 同源染色体对：母源/父源两条，可标基因位点与交叉互换（chiasma），separation 控制减数分裂中的分离; distal chromatid color and allele exchange after chiasma
primitives.signature: ({ cx, cy, len, chiasma, separation, maternal, paternal, loci, progress, exchange })

primitives.name: LinkageMap
primitives.summary: 遗传连锁图：按 cM 排布基因位点，可选高亮两位点间的重组率 RF（并换算成 cM）
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, w, loci: [{cM, label}], highlight, rf, color, progress })

primitives.name: Punnett
primitives.summary: 庞纳特方格：母本配子横向、父本纵向，格内按组合函数填基因型（默认显性字母在前），逐格揭示
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, cell, gam1, gam2, combine, color, progress })

primitives.name: DnaHelix
primitives.summary: DNA 双螺旋：两条正弦链 + 碱基横档；replication>0 时中点张开成复制叉，画出连续的前导链与分段的冈崎片段; fork opening before new-strand synthesis
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, w, amp, turns, replication, color, progress, synthesis })

primitives.name: CodonFlow
primitives.summary: 中心法则的一段：DNA 模板 → mRNA 密码子 → 氨基酸链，按 progress 逐个密码子推进并高亮当前密码子; distinct transcription RNA-only and translation peptide modes; transcript release and peptide bond connections
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, dna, codonTable, cell, progress, color, mode, release })

primitives.name: SignalingCascade
primitives.summary: 磷酸化级联：一串激酶按 progress 逐级活化并挂上 P 标记，末端接出细胞响应
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, steps, gap, color, response, progress })

primitives.name: FeedbackLoop
primitives.summary: 负反馈回路：环形节点（刺激→感受器→效应器→响应），响应以 ⊣ 抑制回起点，中心显示当前值对设定点的偏差; visible controlled-value gauge and set point
primitives.signature: ({ cx, cy, r, nodes, value, setPoint, color, progress, range })

primitives.name: BiologyCoverFigures
primitives.summary: 12 个知识点封面的学科原语组合图，复用 Bio.tsx 的 L2 图形

notes: 配色族 okabe-ito-dark：Okabe-Ito / Wong 2011（8 色安全集，去 #000000）
所有显示的数字必须由函数产出，不要在场景里写字面量
